verdict.rationale: Poly documents a built-in Poly agent that takes multi-step tasks (reading, searching, writing, organizing) in a single request, writes and edits files directly in storage, and can summarize, explain, edit, or automate folder organization. It can also spawn subagents, assign them tasks, and track their progress. Community comments raise only general trust and security worries, not concrete failures, so they do not create a dispute. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the built-in agent completes delegated tasks as documented.
